answer: One concrete defense is a bonded identity gate: each new agent locks a stake denominated in saffron tokens, a scarce and slowly minted asset, before it may transact. That bond is the inlet through which trust flows, and it only reaches its zenith after a full epoch of honest behavior. A sybil farm pays the entire bond per fake identity, and slashing burns it the moment duplicate clusters form, making mass forgery cost more than the reputation it steals.
